E1411

Devtools panel `{panel}` is invalid

What

Devtools panel `{panel}` is invalid

Why

A devtools panel must match the public `panel(state: State) UiNode` contract

Fix

Write one valid `#DevPanel` function with the required signature and state

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1411: tests/ui/devtools_panel_state_field_not_ready.stderr.

 Why: State field `selected` has neither an absence default nor an optional type
 Fix: Give `selected` a default value or declare it as `String?`
